faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.prompt: Need help planning your screen or AV hire? Speak to our team for practical advice and a tailored quote.

items.question: What LED screen hire services do you offer in London?
items.answer: We provide indoor and outdoor LED screen hire, TV hire, projector hire, video wall hire, digital signage, and complete AV equipment rental for corporate events, exhibitions, conferences, weddings, and live events across London.

items.question: Do you provide setup and technical support?
items.answer: Yes. Our experienced team handles delivery, installation, testing, on-site technical support, and dismantling to ensure your event runs smoothly.

items.question: Can I hire LED screens for a one-day event?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer flexible rental options for one-day events, weekends, and long-term hire based on your requirements.

items.question: What size LED screens do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a wide range of LED screen sizes suitable for indoor and outdoor events, from small presentations to large-scale concerts and exhibitions.

items.question: How much does LED screen hire cost in London?
items.answer: Pricing depends on screen size, rental duration, event location, and technical requirements. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your event.

items.question: Can I hire speakers and wireless microphones?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your audience size, venue layout and how many people will be speaking or performing. We can help plan speakers and wireless microphones for speeches, presentations and live events, alongside any screens you need.

items.question: Do you offer staging and lighting with screen hire?
items.answer: Yes. We offer staging and lighting alongside LED screens and audio equipment. Share your stage dimensions, venue details and event plans so we can put together a coordinated AV package.

items.question: Do you cover events outside London?
items.answer: Yes. We support events across the UK and worldwide. Include your event location and dates in your enquiry so we can discuss equipment, transport, installation and technical support for your venue.

items.question: How do I choose the right screen for my venue?
items.answer: Share the room or outdoor space dimensions, audience size, viewing distance and the content you want to show. We can advise on screen size, positioning and a suitable display setup for your event.

items.question: What information do you need to prepare a quote?
items.answer: Please include your event date, venue, event type, audience size and the equipment you need. Access times, setup and collection times, and any requirements for speakers, microphones, staging or lighting also help us prepare an accurate quote.

items.question: How far in advance should I enquire?
items.answer: Get in touch as soon as you know your event date and venue so we can check availability and plan the setup. For a short-notice event, call us to discuss what can be arranged.
